subject: infoschema: avoid panic when updating infoschema v2 btree conflicts (#58815)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: only `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go` changes. `btreeSet` now retries CAS on conflicts (instead of panicking), which matches the expected concurrent-writer scenario (e.g. `InfoCache.Insert()` can spawn `gcOldVersion()` concurrently with schema updates). `Data.GCOldVersion` now checks CAS results and logs conflicts rather than silently ignoring them; worst-case it skips compaction and retries later. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata consistency, or concurrency semantics for infoschema v2.
